race.comment: MAYFAIR (11) resumes as the horse with the strongest overall form profile, having contested the Listed Magic Millions Cup before the break and finished a sound fourth in Class 4 company at the Gold Coast the start prior. The ten-month absence is the obvious concern, but two solid trials give him a platform to return sharply. Go close. AHELLBENDA (5) brings a more current platform after closing into second in a BM64 at Hawkesbury, and third-up she looks ready to convert if she can overcome the sticky draw. ARISTOCRAT (1) was beaten only half a length first-up in a BM74 at Queanbeyan and has a win from two starts at this track, though the draw and top weight keep him honest. Place best. BARBAROSSA (6) has placed at his past two, including a second at this venue, and the weight relief after his Kembla Grange Class 1 placing keeps him well in the argument. Hard fit and gets his chance from the draw. ROCKTHEVELIO (13) progressive mare who looks up to this first up. Respect.
